catalog.description: The catalog: an Iceberg REST catalog, or AWS Glue.

warehouse.description: The REST catalog's warehouse, or Glue's location for new tables, such as s3://bucket/prefix.

namespace.description: Used when the pipeline names no namespace. Created if missing.

credential.description: REST: OAuth2 client credentials, as client_id:client_secret.

region.description: The AWS region of Glue and S3.

accessKeyId.description: An AWS access key for Glue and S3. Without one, the AWS default credentials.

s3Endpoint.description: An S3-compatible endpoint, for stores other than AWS. Uses path-style addressing.

properties.description: More catalog and file IO properties, as Iceberg names them.
